gloss: to be photographed, to appear (in a photo)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {写|うつ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be photographed, to come out (in a photo)
definitions.explanation: For a person or thing to appear in a photograph or image. Describes how well or clearly the subject is captured.

definitions.gloss: to be copied, to be reproduced
definitions.explanation: For something to be transcribed or reproduced onto paper or another surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{写|うつ}った。
examples.english: It came out nicely in the photo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}くて→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{写|うつ}って⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It was dark and the face didn't come out well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{写|うつ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Mt. Fuji appears in the background.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦コピー{機|き}→コピー機：23548_kopiiki⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{写|うつ}らない。
examples.english: The copier is old, so the text doesn't come out clearly.

examples.japanese: {集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ちゃんと→ちゃんと：02359_chanto⟧{写|うつ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked whether everyone came out properly in the group photo.

examples.japanese: ⟦カーボン{紙|し}→カーボン紙：26443_kaabonshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{写|うつ}る。
examples.english: If you use carbon paper, it copies onto the sheet underneath.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Pair: ⟦{写|うつ}す→写す：01227_utsusu⟧ (transitive, to copy/photograph).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{写|うつ}る (appear in a photo)
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{写|うつ}る (come out nicely)
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{写|うつ}る (come out well)
- {写|うつ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is shown/captured in)

WATCH OUT:
- {写|うつ}る: to be photographed, to be copied
- ⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧: to be reflected, to be projected on screen
- ⟦{移|うつ}る→移る：01232_utsuru⟧: to move, to transfer

{写|うつ}る focuses on photographic and copy reproduction, while ⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧ is about reflections and on-screen images.
